story:
Title: Lunchtime with a Friend

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved spending her days in school. One of her favorite parts of her day was lunchtime with her best friend, Max. They would always sit at the same table, sharing their snacks and laughing about silly things. Lily would help Max with his homework, and Max would help Lily with hers. After school, they would walk home together, chatting and laughing until the evening.

Lily's parents used to be very busy, so they couldn't always spend time with Lily and Max. But they would make sure to make time for them on weekends and during the holidays. Lily's parents would buy them special lunches and snacks, and they would take them to fun places to eat and play.

Even though life got busy now, Lily still smiled whenever she remembered those simple and happy days with Max. She cherished the memories they shared and the laughter they made together. She knew that even though they couldn't spend time with each other every day, they would always be friends and she would always be grateful for the memories they had made.
